name: CWF commissioning
description: Clean-water commissioning run for the lab rig. V1 and V3 are open whenever the pump runs. The 5-second prime and 30-second observation are adjustable commissioning intervals. Set the desktop pressure stop threshold to 80 psi and confirm a valid calibrated SVP (GPIO36) pressure reading before starting. The final step stops the pump and turns all valves off.

steps.name: Stop pump and close all valves
